entities.summary: Moez Echargui is a Tunisian tennis player. He has a career high ATP singles ranking of world No. 134 achieved on 29 December 2025 and a career high ATP doubles ranking of No. 362 achieved on 27 May 2019. He is currently the No. 1 African and No. 1 Tunisian player.
